verdict.rationale: Plaid IDV has a documented API with endpoints such as /identity_verification/retry and registrable webhooks (STEP_UPDATED, STATUS_UPDATED, RETRIED), so some UI-side actions are available programmatically. However, the docs describe several actions only in the Dashboard or no-code editor: overriding a failed result (the 'Override Result' button), building verification templates and workflows, and viewing risk factors. Nothing establishes UI-to-API parity, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. Missing for 10: documented API equivalents for result overrides, template/workflow editing and risk-factor detail, and any explicit parity statement or published API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: /identity_verification/retry | Allow a user to retry an identity verification
You can select which events you want to subscribe to. For Identity Verification, there are three events: STEP_UPDATED, STATUS_UPDATED, RETRIED
